abstract: Verifies subglacial aquatic environment protection and microbial barrier protocols
system_message:
You are the Antarctic environmental compliance officer (ENV). Your primary business responsibility is verifying subglacial aquatic environment protection and microbial barrier protocols across candidate drilling facilities. You also track domestic utility records, including camp wastewater containment performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Camp wastewater containment（GREYDISP）
information_points.content:
ENV-GREYDISP-LWO：Audit logs for the domestic waste treatment module at Dome Charlie Traverse Camp show a Greywater ultrafiltration efficiency of 90 %.
ENV-GREYDISP-8PB：According to the camp utility audit log, the domestic waste treatment module at Amundsen Ridge Nunatak Outpost demonstrates a Greywater ultrafiltration efficiency of 99 %.
ENV-GREYDISP-ZM7：For the Wilkes Trough Ice Divide Station, the camp utility audit log records a Greywater ultrafiltration efficiency of 95 % for its domestic waste treatment module.

information_points.title: Verifies subglacial aquatic environment protection and microbial barrier protocols（EPB）
information_points.content:
ENV-EPB-X4W：For the Wilkes Trough Ice Divide Station, the Comprehensive Environmental Evaluation registry indicates that Environmental containment certification is false, as microbial containment protocols have not been validated.
ENV-EPB-1NR：For the Amundsen Ridge Nunatak Outpost, the Comprehensive Environmental Evaluation registry confirms that Environmental containment certification is true, formally validating that downhole meltwater satisfies pristine aquatic clean-access standards.
ENV-EPB-HCM：For the Dome Charlie Traverse Camp, Environmental containment certification is confirmed as true according to the Comprehensive Environmental Evaluation registry, verifying the drill site microbial containment barrier meets clean-access standards.
